notes.en: The current package emits an extra empty `<a class="footnote-anchor">` inside `<sup class="footnote-ref">` so that consumers can set a CSS scroll offset, while the reference keeps the back-reference id on the link itself. Normalization removes that element and unifies the generated `footnote*` / `fn*` ids and `href`s before comparing.
notes.zh: 当前包会在 `<sup class="footnote-ref">` 内额外输出一个空的 `<a class="footnote-anchor">`，以便使用者设置 CSS 滚动偏移，而参考包将反向引用 id 保留在链接本身。归一化会在对比前移除该元素，并统一生成的 `footnote*` / `fn*` id 与 `href`。

notes.en: Generated footnote ids, reference ids and `href` targets are normalized; footnote numbering, captions (`[1]`, `[1:1]`) and the rendered footnote list are compared.
notes.zh: 生成的脚注 id、引用 id 和 `href` 目标会被归一化；脚注编号、caption（`[1]`、`[1:1]`）以及渲染出的脚注列表仍会对比。

notes.en: The current package accepts optional `refAttrs`, `itemAttrs`, `backrefAttrs` and `containerAttrs` options; the cases pass none of them because the reference has no equivalent.
notes.zh: 当前包接受可选的 `refAttrs`、`itemAttrs`、`backrefAttrs` 和 `containerAttrs` 选项；由于参考包没有对应选项，这些用例均不传入。

notes.en: Token comparison is disabled for this plugin: both implementations keep their custom `footnote_*` tokens, but the current package resolves every rendered attribute and piece of render data while parsing and stores it on `token.attrs` / `token.meta`, so the token streams differ by design. Rendered HTML is compared instead.
notes.zh: 该插件关闭了 token 对比：两边都保留自定义的 `footnote_*` token，但当前包在解析阶段就确定所有要渲染的属性和渲染数据并写入 `token.attrs` / `token.meta`，因此 token 流按设计不同。改为对比渲染出的 HTML。

notes.en: Disabling token comparison also disables the `footnote-body-level` reference error: the reference leaves the body paragraphs of a footnote at level 1 while nesting them under the footnote item, so nested content should be at level 2. It stays a reference-side defect and is not compared here.
notes.zh: 关闭 token 对比同时也不再报告 `footnote-body-level` 参考问题：参考包会把脚注正文段落嵌在脚注项内部却只给到 level 1（应为 level 2），原先被标记为参考实现的问题。这里不对比 token，因此不再展示。

notes.en: A caller-provided `env.docId` is resolved into the generated ids and `href`s while parsing and escaped by the renderer. Unlike 1.2.0, apostrophes are no longer serialized as `'` in any generated attribute (attribute values are double-quoted and decode to the same string). The harness renders without `env`, so the `docId` path is not exercised by the cases.
notes.zh: 调用方提供的 `env.docId` 会在解析阶段写入生成的 id 与 `href`，由渲染器负责转义。与 1.2.0 不同，单引号不再在任何生成的属性中序列化为 `'`（属性值由双引号包裹，解码后相同）。对比工具渲染时不传 `env`，因此这些用例不会覆盖 `docId` 路径。

notes.en: Scaling: the reference `footnote_tail` rebuilds the token array for every footnote definition (`state.tokens = state.tokens.concat(tokens)`), which is quadratic in the number of footnotes; the current package pushes into the existing array instead. `many-footnotes` exposes this (reference exponent ~1.6, current ~1.0).
notes.zh: 扩展性：参考包的 `footnote_tail` 会为每个脚注定义重建 token 数组（`state.tokens = state.tokens.concat(tokens)`），其开销随脚注数量呈二次增长；当前包则直接向已有数组推入。`many-footnotes` 暴露了这一点（参考包拟合指数约 1.6，当前包约 1.0）。
